title: Siren's Stoneworks
description: This Datapack endeavors to emulate create's style of stonecutting with the blocks of stoneworks.
body:
This Datapack endeavors to emulate [The Create Mod's](https://modrinth.com/mod/stoneworks) style of stonecutting in which any block of a given type can be used to create any block of that type. 

For example this means that a Prismarine Block can be used to make a Prismarine Brick and that same Prismarine Brick can be used to make a Prismarine Block, Tile, Pillar or any other variant of Prismarine. 

This style of stonecutting is simply much more friendly towards builder in my opinion as its more generous on guessing how many of a given block you need without wasting any extras that are leftover as you can just use them to craft something else!

**I upload this with my full permission for others to use it however they please, in modpacks or to add to it as they like.**
